summary: Wrote a two-phase implementation plan for the stale .claude/ tree. Because the research dispatch already ran deploy-headless.sh and verified all six named extensions FRESH, the plan is a confirm-and-close sequence rather than a fresh repair: Phase 1 re-probes per-extension freshness via deploy-freshness-lib.sh and check-deploy-freshness.sh to decide whether drift has recurred; Phase 2 conditionally redeploys under the bounded-wait idiom and discharges the complete verify-deploy.sh gate set (no --skip-slow), which the research phase explicitly scoped out. Phase 2 declares the __WHOLE_TREE__ sentinel because deploy-headless.sh regenerates the entire deployed tree.

artifacts.summary: Two-phase confirm-and-close plan: re-probe per-extension deploy freshness, then conditionally redeploy and discharge the full verify-deploy.sh gate set.
